androidtv.notes: New Music tab: search artists, albums and songs, rows made from what you play and heart, a Now playing screen with queue, shuffle and repeat, and ListenBrainz sign-in. Hold OK on a song for more options. Add a music addon in Music > Addons to play songs.

phone.notes: New Music tab: search and browse artists, albums and songs, rows made from what you play and heart, a mini player with queue, shuffle and volume that keeps playing with the screen off, and ListenBrainz sign-in. Add a music addon in Music > Addons to play songs.

windows.notes: Sign in to ListenBrainz (Music > Addons) and the songs you play and heart follow you across your devices.
